from build123d import *
import math

outer_diameter = 80.0
plate_thickness = 10.9
boss_diameter = 15.2
boss_height = 5.8
pocket_diameter = 58.2
pocket_depth = 2.3
central_hole_diameter = 3.6
hole_diameter = 10.9
hole_count = 8
hole_radius = (pocket_diameter / 2) - 7.7

part = Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(outer_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)
part = part + Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness + boss_height / 2) * Cylinder(boss_diameter / 2, boss_height)
part = part - Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness - pocket_depth / 2) * Cylinder(pocket_diameter / 2, pocket_depth)
part = part - Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(central_hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)

for i in range(hole_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / hole_count)
    px = hole_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
    part = part - Pos(px, py, plate_thickness / 2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness)

part.name = "plate_with_boss_and_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
